items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: Oh, they had, you see, Oyl Fushey, my nephew Sidney Brown, Andrew Morgan, Johnny Dave, Shine, Sam Morgan, Isaiah and myself.

ctx.x: Can you tell us a bit more about the Sam or the Isaiah Morgan band? Who else was in that band when you joined?

Oh, they had, you see, Oyl Fushey, my nephew Sidney Brown, Andrew Morgan, Johnny Dave, Shine, Sam Morgan, Isaiah and myself. And we just knew that woman, May, Piano, May. Sometimes we used Piano, you know, May, May, Piano.
Who else did you use on Piano later?

items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: But anyway, well, Jim Robison was in the band.

ctx.x: that straight. It wasn't that part of Sam's band. Yeah. Well, that's before we joined the band

with Sam. So, my brother was playing up here on Liberty Street. I just forget the name of the place. But anyway, well, Jim Robison was in the band. In your little band? Yeah. And that's Young Morgan. Yeah, the young one. Sidney Brown, that was the bass player. And Johnny Deve was playing banjo. No, I think we had at that time on the drum, Rudolph. I just can't think of Rudolph's last name.

Is that Bollier? Bollier? Bollier, that's, yeah. Big Rudolph. Yeah. So, um... He'd been sick, had a stroke some time ago. Well, that's what I heard. But we interviewed him about a month ago, and he looks in pretty good health. So, he'd like to play again now. That's good. And they'd be able to start in again.

items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: Andrew Morgan. He's on tenor. Bill Jim was on... ...bass. Johnny Dave was on... ...banjo. Myself was on drum... Myself was on drum... Myself was on trombone.

ctx.x: ...but, uh... ...Oil Fushey on... ...on... ...on... ...on... ...Oil Fushey on, uh... ...on the alto sax. Andrew Morgan. He's on tenor. Bill Jim was on... ...bass. Johnny Dave was on... ...banjo. Myself was on drum... Myself was on drum... Myself was on trombone. And Roy was on, uh... ...Roy was on drums. Roy, Roy Evans.
How many times did you record?
